title: Load and play a selected recitation
description: This test verifies that a user can open the reader, choose a surah, and start audio playback successfully.

steps.description: Select a surah from the list
Verify the selected surah is active
Verify audio playback is in progress

title: Change playback behavior while listening
description: This test verifies that a user can adjust repeat or auto-next settings during recitation and continue listening with the chosen behavior applied.

steps.description: Select a surah from the list
Verify the playback behavior setting is applied

title: Seek through a recitation
description: This test verifies that a user can move backward or forward within a recitation and continue from the new position.

steps.description: Select a surah from the list
Seek backward or forward in the track
Verify audio playback continues from the new position

title: Skip between tracks during listening
description: This test verifies that a user can move to the previous or next track while listening and keep audio playback working.

steps.description: Select a surah from the list
Skip to the previous or next track

title: Browse avatars and buy one with points
description: This test verifies that a user can view avatars, purchase one with points, and see the updated selection afterward.

title: Check for updates and open the release page when available
description: This test verifies that a user can check for updates, see update details when a newer version exists, and open the release download page from settings.

steps.description: Verify update details are visible when a new version is available

title: Confirm the app is already up to date
description: This test verifies that a user can check for updates in settings and see the up-to-date state when no update is available.

steps.description: Verify an up-to-date state is visible

title: Keep browsing after a successful avatar purchase
description: This test verifies that a user can buy an avatar and continue browsing other avatars without leaving the shop.

steps.description: Verify the purchased avatar remains selected
Verify other avatars are still available to browse

title: Continue listening after changing reader context
description: This test verifies that a user can navigate away from the reader and return without losing the selected recitation state.

steps.description: Select a surah from the list
Verify the previously selected surah remains active
Verify the recitation state is restored

title: Navigate between home, reader, shop, and settings
description: This test verifies that a user can move between the main app sections from home and each destination remains reachable.

steps.description: Verify the settings section is displayed
Verify the main sections remain accessible

title: Prevent buying an avatar without enough points
description: This test verifies that the shop blocks a purchase when the user does not have sufficient points and keeps the current balance unchanged.

steps.description: Choose an avatar that costs more points than available
Verify an insufficient points message is visible
Verify the avatar selection does not change

title: Stay on the same avatar after repeated purchase attempts
description: This test verifies that repeated rapid purchase attempts do not create multiple avatar purchases or duplicate point deductions.

steps.description: Attempt to complete the purchase twice quickly
Verify only one purchase is recorded
